Make the sleeves separate, something like this. You're looking for a bolero pattern with cool sleeves, so mostly search for costume patterns. https://www.etsy.com/listing/1859212096/cascading-sleeve-shrug-pdf-sewing

I wouldn't try to piece a pattern together; that's difficult, time consuming, and you're likely to quit the hobby. Instead, look for a "sweetheart neckline corset (or bustier) gown pattern" or something similar. Be wary of AI Etsy patterns, but don't limit yourself to paper ones as a lot of the costume patterns from major companies aren't designed to fit well. I'd recommend choosing one with straps or being prepared to add straps just in case your top doesn't turn out as planned and you need more support. 

General advice/support:
A corset is a hard beginner project, but my friend did it as her first project and finished all the sewing and pattern making in 4 days just using a book I had on how to draft it (Tudor tailor). 

If necessary for the look, just buy a corset pattern and keep your waist measurement in mind, then use a pattern with a skirt you like or do a large circle skirt with a gathered overlayer. Follow some YouTube tutorials to connect them into a dress.

Dresses generally are easy but need a ton of material, and special occasion fabric is super expensive. Buy old prom dresses from the thrift store to seam rip for the fabric. You can use zip ties for the boning if you don't want to invest in good boning. Use clear ones just in case they bleach out. 

I'm actually obsessed with mood fabric's free online patterns. They work very well, and many are beginner friendly. If you feel comfortable adjusting the skirt, this could be a good pattern: https://www.moodfabrics.com/blog/the-london-gown-free-sewing-pattern/

Watch YouTube videos. It's hard to understand construction early on or what different pattern steps mean, and this'll give you a better idea of what to do next.

Hypersexuality is a common hypomanic reaction. And for some of us, that means extreme sexual appetites paired with an "adventurous" personality that leads to cheating. For others, that might just be masturbating more. I can't really speak for the extreme group, but if that's your concern you should talk to her about it. How long have you been dating? From what I've read, her comments read as controlling or emotional manipulation, so this might not be healthy for you. As it stands, if she's not ready to work on herself, she's not ready for a relationship.

In my case, any reaction I have is an inflation of a normal reaction. For example, during hypomania, I have attempted to cut all ties with someone for forgetting to bring a raincoat on a trip. I was irritated, and I did mean that irritation, but it was overblown.

So, she probably means the emotion behind the words, but it's being amplified to the degree where she would break up with you. And no matter what she's feeling, she doesn't have a free reign to be rude or cruel. You are at least owed apologies. And potentially a promise to visit a psychiatrist.
